Rich hand-painted pre-rendered 2.5D game art, crisp silhouette readable at 80 pixels tall, restrained highlights and detailed cloth, inspired by gloomy fantasy tower defense. Fixed isometric 3/4 front view from slightly above, character faces down-right in ALL cells. Same character proportions, same camera, same scale, identical foot anchor centered at 88 percent cell height, at least 8 percent blank gutter inside every cell; staff and all glows must stay inside each cell. TOP ROW 4 frames of subtle idle breathing loop: resting, slight inhale, peak inhale, settling. BOTTOM ROW 4 frames of casting: gathering emerald power in free hand, arm rises, arm extended releasing a small green spell at staff tip, recovery. Keep feet fixed and character identity identical in all frames. Actual transparent alpha background in all unused pixels, no floor, no baked shadows, no scenery, no platform, no checkerboard painting, no watermark. This is usable sprite artwork, not a mockup.
